_note: SIMULATED terms for The Grand prototype. Fictional, not legal text, and not any operator's terms.

clauses.heading: About these terms
clauses.text: These simulated terms describe how The Grand prototype works. Credits are fictional, have no monetary value and cannot be withdrawn.
clauses.plain: Everything here is pretend: the credits aren't real money and can't be cashed out.

clauses.heading: Age
clauses.text: The Grand is an 18+ concept. By playing you confirm you are 18 or over.
clauses.plain: You have to be 18 or older to play.

clauses.heading: Bonus wagering
clauses.text: Bonus credits must be wagered the stated number of times on eligible games before they convert to regular credits. Only eligible games count towards wagering.
clauses.plain: You have to play bonus credits through the stated number of times, on eligible games, before they become normal credits.

clauses.heading: Bonus expiry
clauses.text: Unclaimed bonuses expire at the time shown on the offer. Claimed bonus credits that have not met wagering expire 7 days after claiming.
clauses.plain: Unclaimed bonuses end at the time on the offer, and claimed bonus credits go 7 days after claiming if wagering isn't done.

clauses.heading: Maximum win from bonus play
clauses.text: Winnings from bonus credits are capped at the maximum win shown on the offer. Anything above the cap is removed when wagering completes.
clauses.plain: You can only win up to the maximum shown on the offer from bonus credits; anything over it is taken off.

clauses.heading: Welcome offer eligibility
clauses.text: The welcome offer is available once per player, on a new account only.
clauses.plain: You can get the welcome offer once, and only on a new account.

clauses.heading: Entering competitions
clauses.text: Where a competition requires opt-in, only play after opting in counts. Opting in is free and does not require a deposit.
clauses.plain: If a competition needs you to opt in, only play after you opt in counts, and opting in is free.

clauses.heading: Scoring and ties
clauses.text: Scores are calculated as described on each competition. Ties are broken by whoever reached the score first.
clauses.plain: Each competition explains its own scoring, and if two players tie, whoever got there first wins.

clauses.heading: Prizes and results
clauses.text: Prizes are fictional credits, credited within 24 hours of the competition ending. Results show anonymised display names.
clauses.plain: Prizes are fictional credits paid within 24 hours of the end, and results show anonymised names.

clauses.heading: Using free spins
clauses.text: Free spins can only be used on the eligible games shown, at the fixed spin value shown, before they expire.
clauses.plain: Free spins only work on the games listed, at the spin value shown, before they run out.

clauses.heading: Free spin winnings
clauses.text: Winnings from free spins are paid as bonus credits, subject to the wagering and maximum win shown on the offer.
clauses.plain: What you win from free spins comes as bonus credits, with the offer's wagering and maximum win applied.

clauses.heading: Deposits and withdrawals
clauses.text: In this prototype no real payments are possible. Banking rules are shown for demonstration only.
clauses.plain: No real money can be paid in or out of this prototype; the banking rules are only for show.

clauses.heading: Verification
clauses.text: Before a first withdrawal, players must verify their identity and address.
clauses.plain: You have to prove who you are and where you live before your first withdrawal.

clauses.heading: Pending withdrawals
clauses.text: Withdrawals stay pending for 24 hours and cannot be reversed once requested.
clauses.plain: A withdrawal waits 24 hours, and once you've asked for it you can't cancel it.

clauses.heading: Limits and breaks
clauses.text: Players can set deposit, loss and time limits, take a break, or self-exclude at any time. Reducing a limit takes effect immediately.
clauses.plain: You can set limits, take a break or self-exclude whenever you want.

clauses.heading: Offers and wellbeing
clauses.text: Players who self-exclude, take a break, or reach a limit do not receive offers.
clauses.plain: If you self-exclude, take a break or hit a limit, you won't be sent offers.

clauses.heading: Your data
clauses.text: Progress in this prototype is stored only in your browser and can be wiped at any time from Settings.
clauses.plain: Your progress is only saved in your browser, and you can wipe it from Settings.
